svg.aria-label: Line chart of the memory used by the grpc build over time. Each point is the highest value in the preceding 10 seconds. pie install -j8 (default): peak 7,212 MiB, ended at 5 min 44 s. pie install -j4: peak 4,645 MiB, ended at 10 min 14 s. pie install -j2: peak 2,870 MiB, ended at 17 min 52 s. pecl install (one job): peak 1,747 MiB, ended at 33 min 7 s. A dashed line marks the 7,834 MiB Docker had.
svg.title: Memory of the grpc build over time
svg.text: Memory of the grpc build over time, by number of make jobs (highest value in each 10 s)
